title: Three Summers and One Short Crate
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：seed　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 seed 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the grower ① sowed the seed that no buyer in the greenhouse would have measured, and he said the sowing was the whole of the summer. The ② seed, meaning the grain itself and not the crate, ran three summers and stayed unmeasured in the book; a seed, he said, is the only thing in a greenhouse that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ seed in that greenhouse had the same short crate beside it, and the ④ seed at the far shelf, meaning the bundle they kept for the children to tie and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A seed, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the grower said the measuring is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the seed was the whole of the matter, meaning the hope and not the grain. The ⑥ seed, meaning the hope and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; seed, he said, is either something you sow or the only word that means both a grain and a hope. He said the hope is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ seed had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short crate. The ⑧ seed of the whole thing, the grower wrote in August, was one greenhouse and three summers of measuring; seed, he said, is either the bundle at the far shelf or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ seed I remember is the grain measured in the ledger, which closed in 1968 and is still measured as the quietest in the greenhouse. A ⑩ seed, my mother said in 1970, is the only grain that improves by being measured; every seed, she said, is a hope that has agreed to look like a grain. She said the hope was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 种子（指大棚里每一粒旁边的那一粒）
B. n. 种子（指那粒种子本身，与浅浅的木箱相对）
C. 固定搭配：sow the seed 播这一粒种子
D. n. 种子（指留给孩子们捆的那一捆）
E. n. 种子之事（抽象总称，指一处大棚的种子之事）
F. n. 种子（指收成账里写到、被测量的那一粒）
G. n. 种子、希望（指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 希望（抽象总称，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: sowed the seed that no buyer in the greenhouse would have measured
The seed, meaning the grain itself and not the crate
the seed at the far shelf
the seed was the whole of the matter

The seed of the whole thing

answers.why: sow the seed 意为“播这一粒种子”，1961 年那位种植户把大棚里没有一位收购人肯测量的一粒种子做了一遍。
seed 意为“种子”，指那粒种子本身而不是浅浅的木箱，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被测量。
seed 意为“种子”，指大棚里每一粒旁边的那一粒，每一粒旁边都有同一只浅浅的木箱。
seed 意为“种子”，指最远那层架位的留给孩子们捆的那一捆，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
seed 意为“种子、希望”，指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这粒希望就是那件事的全部。
seed 意为“希望”，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西而不是那粒种子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
seed 意为“种子”，指收成账里写到、被测量的那一粒，到 1966 年这一粒成了收成账里的一行。
seed 意为“种子之事”，种植户八月写道，整件事的种子之事是一处大棚和三个夏天的测量。
seed 意为“种子”，我记得的是收成账里测量过的那一粒，1968 年收完了，至今仍被说成大棚里最安静的一粒。
seed 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，种子是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的种子。
